verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Vanta manages policies: the AI Agent drafts policies, policies can be listed and uploaded via the API, and agentic search covers policies. Nothing describes a lawyer-grade template library, an in-app editor, version history, approval workflows, or per-employee acceptance tracking. Missing for 10: lawyer-grade policy template library, policy editor, policy versioning, approval workflow, per-employee acceptance/attestation tracking, independent corroboration.
